Every candidate of a grid

Source: R/wildcards.R
get_candidates.Rd

One row per candidate with its class counts, log likelihood, every information criterion and quality measure, and its convergence, boundary and replication status. Columns empty in every row are left out (for a class grid, the covariance model and the Gaussian checks; error when every candidate fitted); get_results(x, "candidates") keeps them.

Usage

get_candidates(x)

Arguments

x

An enumeration grid from enumerate_classes(), enumerate_lpa(), enumerate_lca() or enumerate_regressions().

Value

A data frame, one row per candidate. On a profile or class grid: candidate, n_profiles, n_group_classes, model, log_likelihood, n_parameters, the criteria (aic, bic_groups, ...), profile_entropy, the AvePP summaries, converged, boundary, n_best_replicated, and the Gaussian checks where they apply. A transition or family grid has one entropy, bic and bic_individual, and no AvePP summaries; a regression grid has n_classes, bic, bic_rows, sabic, icl, entropy, smallest_share and best_bic, without candidate or boundary. Any other object raises latents_not_a_fit.

See also

get_best(), get_deltas(), plot_criteria(); get_results() for the columns.

Examples

grid <- enumerate_lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"),
                      n_profiles = 1:3, model = "EEI",
                      n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
get_candidates(grid)
#>   candidate n_profiles n_group_classes model log_likelihood n_parameters
